messages:
Maria (PM): Quick status check on Q4 milestone — what actually shipped vs what slipped? tagging owners @Alex K @Chris L
Alex K: Shipped: UI changes + flagging backend. Canary went out yesterday (10%). All green so far.
Chris L: Slipped: routing optimizer work blocked by infra quota and a DB migration conflict. ETA for unblocking is EOD next Tue unless we get a quick patch.
Suman R: I can bump the quota. @Chris L can you paste the migration error and the PR link?
Chris L: Error: `PG::LockWaitTimeout` when running `bin/rails db:migrate` against prod-mirror. PR #432 has the migration, rolling back for now to avoid perf regression.
Jess D: CR ping on #432 — starting review now, should be able to finish in ~4h. Looks like we might need an index before the migration runs.
Maria (PM): Quick owner recap: Alex = UI & flag rollout, Chris = optimizer + migration, Jess = CR, SRE (Suman) = quota/infra. Next step: Jess reviews, Suman bumps quota, Chris reapplies migration.
Alex K: Note on rollout: feature flag `q4_experiment_v2` is at 10% canary. Observability dashboard: https://dashboard.internal/q4-ship shows latency/error trends — currently steady.
deploy-bot: canary deploy completed for service `redwood-web` version=2.14.3 canary=10% :thumbsup:
Suman R: Done: bumped DB connection pool and raised quota in eu-west-1. Monitoring for 30m then I'll give the green.
Jess D: Reviewed #432 — added index in a follow-up commit and left two small nits. @Chris L you'll need to rebase and squash.
Chris L: Rebased and pushed. Will re-run migration once Suman confirms DB is stable.
Maria (PM): Plan: if Suman confirms within the hour and Jess approves, Chris will requeue migration and we aim for full rollout by Friday. If anything slips, flag here immediately and call out owner. :calendar:
